## What happened?

Describe expected and observed behavior. Distinguish sender acceptance from receiver processing.

## Synthetic reproduction

Provide minimal steps and invented, non-sensitive event content. State whether sending was enabled and whether the event ID was reused. Do not post a live repository URL or token.

## Diagnostics

Include only reviewed, non-sensitive counts, status categories, or sanitized error text. Do not attach the journal, Home Assistant storage, backups, or raw HTTP traces.

## Impact and workaround

Describe the effect and any workaround already tried. Note failed or skipped checks as well as passing ones.
